text:
Source-assisted reading of F-d7a7 (Stams, Stiftsarchiv, Frg. 150). A research reader reread all four strips on both sides on the native images. Read before the source was known, on canvas 0: the question numbers (ccxxx-, ccxl-), "e . t . q", "qui causam dede-", "interdictum", "audiri possint", "possit sacerdos", "in aggrauacionem cessacionis", "beate virginis", "vrticis et spinis", "capella", "sepeliri", "aliquis appellat", "Suspensio ab officio". All of canvas 1 and the full lines below were read with the Tabula printed with the Summa confessorum (Lyon 1518, fol. xv) open beside the image. Regions are x,y,width,height in native pixels. Parentheses expand abbreviations; [..] marks letters lost at the cuts or not read; (?) marks an uncertain reading; z is the sign for "et"; a full stop between spaces is the scribe's point.

Reading order: canvas 1 standalone strip, canvas 1 three adjoining strips, canvas 0 three adjoining strips, canvas 0 standalone strip.
